Research the 3 best budget laptops under ₹50,000 in India right now and compare them
8:39 PM

My top 3 under ₹50,000 are the MSI Modern 14, the Acer Aspire 3 (13th Gen) and the Lenovo IdeaPad 3. All three have 8 GB RAM and a 512 GB SSD, so the processor and price are what set them apart.

MSI Modern 14, AMD Ryzen 5 7430U: ₹49,990. The strongest processor of the three, and the best pick if you want it to last.
Acer Aspire 3, Intel Core i3 13th Gen 1305U: ₹40,990. A newer chip at a middle price. It is the best balance of speed and cost.
Lenovo IdeaPad 3, Intel Core i3 11th Gen: ₹37,890. The cheapest of the three, but the chip is older.

These prices come from one list on TechGyan360, updated Thu 12 Nov 2026, and they show Flipkart prices. The store price is the final one, so check it before you buy. Nothing was booked or bought.
